evidence_plan.requirement: Evaluation criteria used for generated text

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific evaluation criteria and metrics used to assess the generated text, including WER, BLEU score, and human evaluations.

claims.text: The evaluation criteria for the generated text included usability for news production and acceptability by journalists.
Metrics used for evaluation included Word Error Rate (WER) and BLEU score.
The WER for the generated text was reported as 5.6% compared to corrected variants.
The BLEU score achieved by the model was 19.67 on the test set.
